value.rationale: The first tetrahedral pure Morse spaces with the published 81-sphere wedge and unequal face vectors have a natural S4 action, and the boundary has a nontrivial additional ghost involution. The new exact full group character and 45/36 splitting distinguish equivariant information invisible to ordinary homology ranks and group structure; the rational agreement between the two pure complexes is a motivated structural comparison, not an arbitrary finite slice.
